rationale.faithfulness: J invariant at 8/9 steps and at the only step with a first stage (G42), but the first stage fails at 7/7 rule steps, so most of the test is uninformative; power covers only large rewiring. Scorecard A1 B1 C1 D1 E1 F1 G1 H1 I0.
rationale.usefulness: Tells an operator that resets and goal changes do not rewire talk coupling (at |dJ| >= 1.2) and tells analysts that block-field talk J is not a field artifact; small and indirect.

one_line: A fitted talk-spin coupling matrix stays at its day-to-day noise level across field steps, including a goal switch that clearly moved the fields; most documented rule changes do not move talk fields beyond nightly changes.
